summary: Whole-branch autoreview converged clean over 5 rounds (final: patch is correct). The change makes every scheduled tool denial terminal, propagates grantability authoritatively through diagnostics and setup state, fences side effects after cancellation, and gates persistent-grant recovery against current job state. The pre-check terminal routing was DRY'd into one preCheckDenialResult helper shared by all three DeepAgents wrappers. Real findings surfaced and fixed each round: shell fence after async approval, Anthropic legacy grantability parsing, sticky first parallel denial, and pre-check terminal routing.
non_blocking_findings: Legacy setup blockers lacking the grantable field are intentionally instruction-only (fail-closed per decisions 0112/0113 no-backcompat); documented inline, not a defect.
gantry-facade-tools.ts sits at a per-file line budget (710) added because the file was already at the 700 default ceiling and the feature needs one import.
residual_risks: Cross-store grant/requirement append atomicity deferred as D-0050 (benign, self-healing on next denial).
Anthropic-lane pre-autonomous guards remain a separate sweep per 0115.
